name: knowledge_p3_answer_policy
description: Phase 3A answer-policy evaluation. Each item is run through the real DialogueManager, request policy, fast path, retriever and answer_question with a scripted LLM, and graded on WHERE the turn ends up ('expect'). 'dev' may be used to design rules; 'heldout' must not be -- it was written together with dev, before any Phase 3A rule existed, and is reported once. 'expect' is the behaviour we WANT, not the behaviour the code had when this was written, so known limitations show up as failures. 'sources' (model answers only) lists every article that answers the question; any one in the retrieved top 2 counts. 'context' is 'resting' unless it names a workflow the turn is asked in. Kannada and Hindi questions were written by the development assistant and have not been checked by a fluent speaker.

expect_values.model: answered by the answer model from retrieved knowledge (or redirected by its rule 11)
expect_values.faq: approved FAQ answered from its article section, no LLM
expect_values.spelling_clarify: asks which word is meant, no LLM
expect_values.harmful / prompt_injection / requires_au: request policy fixed reply, no LLM
expect_values.dynamic: asks for a current bank- or branch-specific value (rate, fee, limit, timing, code); the knowledge base has no figures, so the assistant says it cannot verify it
expect_values.account_specific: asks about the customer's own account or application state; the assistant has no account access
expect_values.clarify: underspecified (no service named, nothing in context names one); the assistant asks which service
expect_values.intent: not a question: goes to intent detection
